text_block_list.text:
She couldn't claim the crown. Even so, 
Vodka gave it every ounce of her stubborn 
grit and ran a magnificent race!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... Just... one more 
push!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I was just one step away! Dammit! Dammit, 
dammit! But...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
These guys are insane... The Derby is 
seriously insane...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This really was the place I was aiming 
for... Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ah, but it hurts so much... Ugh, uuuu...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No, the thing is... Even I don't know why 
I'm crying.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All I know is, I'm glad I ran... Why the 
heck is the sky so damn blue?!

A once-in-a-lifetime Derby. Vodka ran it 
to the end without ever compromising her 
ideals.

This was probably for the best. At the 
very least, there will be no regrets of "I 
should have run."

And during the press conference that 
followed—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No doubt about it, the winner was 
incredible! I'll admit that much. But 
still...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Who knows what'll happen next! I've got a 
plan to blow right past that!

...They started talking about something 
ominous.

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san, what is this plan?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"To become even bigger and better, I'm 
setting off on an overseas campaign after 
this!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get super strong in no time and 
blow past every single one of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ooooooohh!

An overseas... expedition... Standing 
alone behind the reporters, I held my head 
in my hands...
That night—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My bad! I said I was sorry~! It's not like 
I had any ill intentions, it's just, 
um...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't let it go without doing 
this! It felt like I'd lost otherwise...

Her next race. Considering Vodka's 
aptitude, returning to the Tiara route for 
the Shuka Sho would be the best choice.

However, with an overseas expedition 
squeezed in beforehand, the toll it'll 
take is unpredictable...
choice_data_list: Are you seriously aiming for races abroad?
Are you seriously aiming for races abroad?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I already said it, so it's too 
late to back out now. Not that I plan to, 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, I'm sick of ending up as just 
'pretty decent.' This is the only way to 
prove everyone wrong, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Right? Ple~ase, Trainer? Is that... a no?
choice_data_list:
...After we get back, the Shuka Sho is 
next, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No! Not the Shuka Sho, but overseas...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What do you mean, "After we get 
back"...?
choice_data_list:
Right, once we get back from the overseas 
expedition.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Then Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yay! Yeah, that's the spirit, partner!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You really understand me! Yeah, by the 
time we get back, it'll already be autumn!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's go overseas! And then make a 
triumphant return to the Shuka Sho as 
world-renowned Umamusume!

...And so, we decided to incorporate an 
overseas expedition not originally on the 
rotation.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks once again for letting me run in 
the Derby, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, we're only halfway there. Let's go 
even further together, the two of us!
